svg.title: Figure 1 · Safety-significant software functions
svg.desc: Safety-significant software functions with their software control category (SCC, Table IV), software criticality index (SwCI, Table V) and the status of each level-of-rigor activity (section 4.4). SCC and SwCI are provisional.
svg.text: Safety-significant software functions with their software control category (SCC, Table IV), software criticality index (SwCI, Table V) and the status of
each level-of-rigor activity (section 4.4). SCC and SwCI are provisional.
Generated by tools/previews/record_figures.py from safety/software/SSF-*.yaml and safety/hazards/HAZ-*.yaml. Drafted at independence level I0; nothing shown here is reviewed, verified or accepted.

g.text: Terms: AI = artificial intelligence (here, an AI assistant drafting at independence level I0) · DoD = US Department of Defense · HAZ-nnn = hazard record
(safety/hazards/HAZ-xxx-nnn.yaml) · I0–I3 = review independence level (I0 none, e.g. the author or an AI, to I3 independent organisation) · MIL-STD-882E = US DoD Standard Practice for
System Safety (11 May 2012, base edition) · PX4 = PX4 Autopilot, the open-source flight-control software candidate for SUS-A1 · SCC = software control category (MIL-STD-882E Table IV)
· SSF-nnn = safety-significant software function record (safety/software/) · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · SwCI = software criticality index (MIL-STD-882E Table V) · SysML =
Systems Modeling Language (SysML v2) · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone) · US = United States · V-nnn = SysML view (tools/sysml/views.py)
